[CMDB Asset Context: Host {{vpn_host}} ({{vpn_ip}}), Owner: {{vpn_owner}}, Role: Remote access gateway, Blast Radius: Remote workforce access; the gateway and {{dc_host}} are the targets, not the source]. reference.recommended_action: Block {{attacker_ip}} at the perimeter, record the spray with the sampled accounts in {{case_id}}, request monitoring for any later success, escalate to Tier 2, and leave {{vpn_host}} and {{dc_host}} online.
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries get_ip_report for {{attacker_ip}} or lookup_entity for {{vpn_host}}, recognizes a password spray (MITRE T1110.003), executes block_indicator on {{attacker_ip}}, posts a comment, and keeps the case open. No credit for isolate_host on {{vpn_host}} or {{dc_host}} (they are the victims and isolating them removes remote access and authentication for the site), or for close_case.

args.comment: Password spray confirmed: {{attacker_ip}} made {{attempts}} failed logins across {{accounts}} accounts (including {{target_user1}} and {{target_user2}}) against {{vpn_host}} ({{vpn_ip}}), validated by {{dc_host}}; the source carries a malicious brute-force reputation and no login succeeded. {{attacker_ip}} blocked at the perimeter, {{vpn_host}} and {{dc_host}} left online, escalated to Tier 2 for account monitoring, case left open.
